description: This PHP script handles generating PDFs from templates within the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves modules, templates, and records, cleans and substitutes template content, configures PDF settings, generates PDF documents, creates associated Notes, and manages file output and storage.

classes.name: templateParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing templates with placeholders and replacing them with actual data.

classes.name: PDFWrapper
classes.description: A class wrapping PDF generation functionalities such as configuring, writing headers, footers, HTML content, and outputting the final PDF.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: A static method that processes a template string, replacing placeholders with actual data provided in the context.
